column1: Authentication API: register, login and JWT
column28:
As a visitor I want to register and log in so that I can use protected features (UC-01, UC-02; CF-01, CF-02, CF-03; CN-01).

Acceptance criteria:
- POST /api/auth/register creates a Customer, password hashed with BCrypt, unique e-mail, min. 6 characters
- POST /api/auth/login returns a JWT valid 8 hours with the role claim
- Login limited to 5 attempts per minute per IP
- Default admin account seeded at startup
- Swagger supports Bearer authentication

Add the xUnit test project (xUnit, Moq, FluentAssertions) with unit tests for password hashing (BCrypt), registration/password validation rules, pagination clamping and security configuration values (login rate limit, JWT lifetime). Tests do not use a database (CN-02).

column1: Production front-end build fails and API URL is not applied
column28:
Found while verifying the Docker build.

Steps to reproduce: run `ng build --configuration production` in frontend/.
Actual: 3 errors, component style budgets exceeded at 4 kB (product-list 6.53 kB, checkout 5.16 kB, admin 5.26 kB). Also, angular.json has no fileReplacements, so the production apiUrl is never used and the Docker image would call http://localhost:53158/api.
Expected: production build succeeds and uses the relative URL /api behind nginx.

Fix: add fileReplacements with apiUrl '/api'; raise the component style budget.

column1: .NET target mismatch between projects and Docker/CI
column28:
The API and test projects target net8.0 and use 8.0 packages, but the Dockerfile and the CI workflow use .NET 10 images/SDK, so the container runtime cannot run the published net8.0 app.

Fix: align Dockerfile and CI on .NET 8 (LTS).
